name: Orkas
description: Orkas is an open-source (MIT), local-first AI team for your desktop: a Commander turns your goal into to-dos and coordinates 16 built-in specialist agents plus Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes, with projects, scheduled automations and connectors. Free app for macOS & Windows; built-in models or your own keys.

latest_release.name: Orkas 2026.11.4
latest_release.body:
## v2026.11.4

### Download

[Download Orkas](https://orkas.ai/download/?source=gh-orkas-release&entry_point=github_release&download=1)

### Highlights

- Use GPT-6.1 Terra in supported provider and model settings.
- Choose multiple weekdays or month dates for recurring automations and review clearer schedule summaries.
- Capture product pages and recover video compositions with clearer preview and delivery checks.

### Fixes

- Recover queued messages, selected attachments and interrupted conversations without treating downloaded files as new drafts.
- Keep search results complete through cache rebuilds, file changes, deletion and restoration.
- Preserve both recoverable copies when Library moves encounter concurrent edits or partial deletion.
- Keep desktop background work, shutdown and provider failures consistent with the task's actual completion state.

### Full changelog

[Compare v2026.10.27...v2026.11.4](https://github.com/Orkas-AI/Orkas/compare/v2026.10.27...v2026.11.4)
